title: Read source changes from the intended checkout while Saga lives in a separate repository
preconditions: Create source repository with queue.go and separate documentation repository containing shop Saga; sync documentation to the source baseline.

steps.action: Change and commit queue.go in source with reason Retry enqueue; update and sync the companion documentation, then read status --repo SOURCE --against main.
steps.expected_result: Opening is companion and its cursor equals source head; queue-design is affected by code with reason Retry enqueue from the source repository.

expected_result: Opening is companion and its cursor equals source head; queue-design is affected by code with reason Retry enqueue from the source repository.
